rec: Spear or Hasta for the 3 weapon styles
enemies: Black Golem, Grey Golem, White Golem (Level 75)
rewards: Access to Nardah's Fountain and Shrine

st.t: Speak to Awusah the Mayor in Nardah.
s: I am an adventurer in search of quests.
Any idea how you got this curse?
Ok I will have a look around and see what I can do.

st.t: Speak to Ghaslor the Elder, just north of Awusah.
s: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.

st.t: Open and search the cupboard in the north-west corner of the house that is north of the fountain.
Use the needle and thread on the torn robes (both top and bottom).
Cast the Telekinetic Grab spell on the ancestral key on the table, on the east side of the same house.
Follow the River Elid north from Nardah until it comes out of a cave as a waterfall, or use a necklace of passage to Eagle's Eyrie and go south-west. Use the rope on the root over the cave to enter.
Equip the Robes of Elidinis and use the ancestral key on the door.
Head east from the door you just opened to the three doors. Open the south one and fight the White Golem (level-75). You can only damage the Golem with the stab attack style.
Open the southern door again. Clear the Water Channel, then leave the room.
Open the door to the east and fight the Grey Golem (level-75). You can only damage the Golem with the slash attack style.
Open the eastern door again. Clear the Water Channel with your pickaxe, then leave the room.
Open the door to the north-east and fight the Black Golem (level-75). You can only damage the Golem with the crush attack style.
Open the north-eastern door again. Clear the Water Channel by shooting the target, then leave the room.
Open the door to the north near the lake.
Talk to the Water Spirits on the north side of the lake.
s: I come as an emissary from the people of Nardah.
Is there anything they can do to get their fountain working again?

st.t: Return to Nardah and speak to Awusah the Mayor.
Take the shoes near the doorway then leave Awusah's house.
Use a knife on the shoes to cut out the sole.
Go west from the Nardah general store to the crevice. Use your rope on it to climb down, with a light source in your inventory.
Talk to the Genie in the Crevice.
s: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
Maybe I can make a deal for it?
Ok I agree to the deal.

st.t: Talk to the Genie again with the sole.
Return to Nardah and use the statuette on the statuette plinth in the northern house.
